clips.title: The story
paras: Mebok Mizzyrix seeks Blueleaf Tubers beneath the roots of Razorfen Kraul. The Ratchet goblin merchant sends trained snufflenose gophers to find and dig them up for trade.

Blueleaf tubers are prized as a rare culinary delicacy across the world. They are hard to harvest because they do not grow in open fields or ordinary wild groves. Foragers find them deep underground in the southern Barrens, tangled among the roots of Razorfen Kraul.

Mebok Mizzyrix, a merchant in Ratchet, devised a way to find the buried tubers. He trains snufflenose gophers, whose noses can catch a tuber's scent from fifty paces away. He supplies foragers with a command stick, a ventilated crate, and an instruction manual to guide the creatures through quilboar territory.

Harvesting the tubers means entering the lands of the hostile Death's Head quilboar tribe. Foragers must guard their trained gophers from feral beasts and thorny briars in the Kraul, then command the rodents to dig up the buried bulbs. The tubers go back to Ratchet, where Mizzyrix's foreign buyers await.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Blueleaf tubers are a delicacy around the world! But they're rare, very rare. The only place to find them is here in the Barrens, deep in the earth, in Razorfen Kraul.

And even then, they're impossible to find unless you know just where to look! That's why I've trained these snufflenose gophers to find them for me. They have great noses and can smell a tuber from fifty paces away.
It won't be easy, but if you get me some tubers I'll pay you handsomely.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the tubers, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Great, you got them! I can sell these to my contacts for a bundle!
Thanks for the delivery, friend! You are a great partner.
